description: A stale typed CAS has zero writes and a registered failed_precondition Problem, while any authorized current read is a distinct operation and never an unregistered error extension.

cases.name: stale_cas_has_no_inline_current
cases.given: an authorized Event claims an expected_revision older than the frozen selector revision
cases.action: submit the Event to the current governing Station
cases.observed: Problem response and durable Event, Commit and typed current state
assertions: the response does not invent current, current_result or a generic details bag as machine-readable current

cases.name: authorized_reauthoring_uses_an_independent_read
cases.given: the failed selector has a registered current read path authorized for this caller
cases.action: perform that separate read, verify Realm, complete selector, generation, head and revision, then obtain fresh user confirmation
cases.observed: new signed intent and its own CAS outcome
assertions: the read is not described as data returned in the failed submit response
the new submission still checks the then-current revision

cases.name: unreadable_selector_cannot_be_guessed
cases.given: the current selector is invisible or no registered read path exists
assertions: no current value or hidden selector is disclosed
the client does not infer current from an omitted snapshot entry, error text or stale cache and does not automatically replay the old signature
